cartographic_sources.survey: IGN BD TOPO V3 piste_d_aerodrome / batiment, queried 2026-10-06; complete 685-building area query
cartographic_sources.notes: Surveyed pavement retained in full. Concrete north-west South parking subsection fills an IGN inner ring according to orthophoto/APDC. Service H and business apron digitized on orthophoto. Runway 1800 x 45 m and gendarmerie pad 15 x 15 m anchored to published coordinates. Runway paint schematic. Current APDC replaces old 500-series stand names; stand locations are registered cartographic label positions, not surveyed INS coordinates. HM7 is a chart landmark without an invented building footprint. No yellow guidance lines or stop bars (AD 2.9 NIL).
